summary: Sasol Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for the period ended May 4, 2026. The filing appears to be a routine foreign private issuer report containing graphic images and no substantive special-situation disclosures. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is announced. As a standard periodic report under the 1934 Act, this filing does not constitute a special situation event.
